title: Endomorphisms of regular rooted trees induced by the action of polynomials on the ring Z_d of d-adic integers
notes: Shows that an integer polynomial acting on Z_d induces an endomorphism of the rooted d-ary tree and that its sections are again induced by integer polynomials of the same degree. Proposition 3.4: the endomorphism is finite-state if and only if the polynomial is linear. For d=3 this is the classical classification of finite residual closures of Z[x] section systems; nonlinear polynomials have infinitely many distinct sections.
